Method of Attack: Ransomware attack compromising network and stealing unencrypted files while spreading laterally
Deployment of ransomware on all available devices after gaining access to Windows domain controller
Impacted Systems: Société de transport de Montréal (STM) IT systems, website, customer support, door-to-door paratransit service online registration system
Attack Vector: Network compromise with lateral movement to Windows domain controller
Indicators of Compromise: STM website down, redirected to www.lastm.info
